is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles coluzzii (formerly Anopheles gambiae form M) in the Kou Valley, Burkina Faso (page 2, 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (L1014F) and Ace-1 G280S (G119S) (page 4, 7, Table 4).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 4 provides genotype counts (SS, RS, RR) and allele frequencies for L1014F and G119S for two study arms (page 7).

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted on field-collected Anopheles coluzzii from VK3 village, Burkina Faso (page 2, 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical field study evaluating an insecticide paint intervention.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in VK3 village, Kou Valley, Burkina Faso (page 2, 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted from August to December 2013 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper describes a new field study in VK3 village, distinct from previous studies in VK1 and VK7 (page 2, 7).

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and bioassay results, are provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of an organophosphate-based insecticide paint (Inesfly 5A IGR) applied to doors and windows in VK3 village, Burkina Faso. The study monitored mortality rates of field-collected Anopheles coluzzii and genotyped for kdr (L1014F) and ace-1 (G119S) mutations. Results showed high kdr frequency and low ace-1 frequency in the population.
